AC-001.rationale: Separate discovered skills, callable capability and check verdict; valid layout FAIL/BLOCKED is callable but not passing; respect explicit capability restrictions.

AC-002.rationale: Subprocess fault matrix and real temporary CLI projects distinguish missing entry, dependency, timeout, malformed result, exit mismatch, missing configuration and product violations.

AC-003.rationale: Lifecycle save and reload: five to eight ACs, removals and changed semantics; saved specification remains distinct from planning and execution readiness.

AC-004.rationale: Authorized unambiguous repairs revalidate; unauthorized repairs remain reviewable proposals; ambiguous methods require decisions and do not fabricate evidence.

AC-005.rationale: Persist task/reference/revision/hash-bound branch recovery; unrelated authorized branches proceed; stale contracts cannot reuse authority.

AC-006.rationale: Fake clock and call-count assertions: identical failed inputs do not repeat; finite temporary retries preserve exhausted state; changed repair evidence permits recheck.

AC-007.rationale: Legacy state compatibility, schema and documentation consistency, source and assembled package regression.

AC-008.rationale: Isolated synthetic SPEC-0058-like end-to-end case exposes capability, AC mapping and layout gaps independently without accessing the real project.
